summary: Anachrony is a heavy sci-fi worker-placement game about rebuilding civilization after a cataclysm, with a signature time-travel mechanic where Exosuits sent to the past let players borrow future resources at a cost. It's dense with interlocking contracts, tech tracks, and production systems aimed at serious euro gamers.
praised: innovative and thematic time-travel loop mechanic
criticised: steep learning curve and heavy rules overhead
catch-up disaster track can feel frustrating to some

interaction.kind: worker placement blocking on a shared action board plus a shared end-game timing race
interaction.detail: Action spaces (including the powerful but limited Exodus/Rift actions) can only be used by one player at a time, so timing a claim to beat a rival is a real tactic, and the paradox/loan mechanics interact with a shared timeline. Most turns, though, are spent optimizing an individual tableau of buildings and resource chains that don't directly touch other players' boards.
interaction.said: Reviewers describe Anachrony as a dense engine-building puzzle where much of the satisfaction comes from optimizing your own production chain, though the shared action-space board and the competitive race to power up (or delay) the Time Rifts add real contested moments

scoring.how_you_win: Send workers through time to build an efficient production engine, construct buildings, advance your ministry track, and complete achievement tiles; the highest combined score when the round track or achievement supply runs out wins.
